terms.binding_label: Requirements treated as binding for government-variant volume
terms.restricted_note: keeping restricted parts with compliant suppliers

text.rules_note: Statutory means a named component category in the FY2020 NDAA §848. Blue UAS Framework (managed by DCMA) is a vetting program, not a statute; the FCC exemption for Blue UAS items runs to 1 Jan 2027 unless extended. Rules also reach any federally funded buyer (American Security Drone Act), not only DoD. Buyer-imposed comes from the customer contract. All are screening inputs, not legal conclusions. Rules last checked 2026-11-01 (demo).
text.spares_note: Spares often cost more for good reasons (small lots, fast delivery). No typical drone-spares markup is published, so treat this as a prompt to ask, not a verdict.
text.rules_change_example: Rules change (e.g. the FCC Blue UAS exemption runs to 1 Jan 2027 unless extended).
text.pilot_scope: one consenting U.S. drone maker, one product family, 2 to 3 BOM revisions, purchased assemblies and recurring spares
match_notes: **Text alone** auto-accepts about 77% of part lines with zero wrong; **supplier-SKU history** (a SKU confirmed once vouches for its other lines) lifts that to {auto_share}.
On **54 fresh descriptions written after tuning** (text only), 42 were auto-accepted with none wrong, and the other 12 went to review with the right guess on top. Small sample.
